feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 May 2026 9:52pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 11 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Flat ridge of high pressure is displaced from the northwest by an approaching frontal system.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, backing west 4 or 5 overnight, veering west or northwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, although falling force 4 at times in the west.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then occasional rain soon approaching from the northwest. This clearing to isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east, veering northwest 5 to 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon building moderate occasionally rough.


##Weather##

Occasional showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
